CustomField.description: SLA remaining percentage at or below which the Agent Work Panel displays the countdown in red (critical). Must be less than SLA_Warn_Threshold_Pct__c. When null, the panel falls back to 20. Subscriber-tunable — admins can relax or tighten the critical band per routing scenario without code changes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Remaining % at which the SLA countdown turns red. Must be < Warn % and >= 0. Defaults to 20 if blank.
CustomField.label: SLA Critical Threshold %
